content:
incident-bot: Pager duty triggered: GPU prefill OOM on rwd-infer-prod-usw2-nt-07 (container restarted). alert: /v1/chat generate error spike > 50/s.

alice_oncall: seeing a bunch of 502s from frontend and container restarts on that node. root container restarted at 16:07:14 UTC. paging now. I’m on it.

priya_sre: @alice_oncall - I can grab node and kube events, pulling logs. looks like prefill sequences with >300k tokens in KV.

cheng: throwing logs here:```
[16:07:12] runtime: CUDA error: out of memory while prefill alloc 2.1GiB
[16:07:12] runtime: killing container rwd-model-96b-abc-7 (OOM)
[16:07:13] k8s: Pod rwd-model-96b-abc-7 restarted (oom_kill)
[16:07:14] runtime: KV cache growth: 1.4GiB -> 3.6GiB during prefill of long prompt
```

david_ml: model: 96B quantized; large context + long system messages can balloon KV. We’ve seen fragmentation when prefill + concurrent streaming hits same device.

maria_cs: any customer impact yet? CX says some enterprise requests got 503s and one reported aborted sessions.

alice_oncall: confirmed: ~1.8% of API calls in the last 5m returned 502/503. top-affected: customers using long-chat-context mode (enterprise).

priya_sre: immediate mitigations I’m applying now: 1) add admission control rule to reject requests with prompt length > 200k tokens to this model pool; 2) enable fallback route to rwd-model-8b-lowmem for new requests; 3) temporarily scale up dedicated coldpool (CPU fallback) for queued long requests. Applying...

ops-bot: admission-rule created: `prefill_max_tokens: 200000` on pool prod-96b. fallback route `96b->8b-lowmem` enabled.

cheng: I pushed a hotfix to runtime to trim prefill KV growth for that pod: `--prefill-kv-max=1Gi` and restarted the runtime process on the node. Rolling restart started (3/5 replicas).

alice_oncall: continuing: cordon node rwd-infer-prod-usw2-nt-07 to avoid noisy neighbor. Moving new pods to other nodes.

david_ml: recommend enabling prefix caching eviction sooner for that model. Also enabling early-fallback policy when prefill alloc > 1Gi to avoid OOM.

priya_sre: did a live patch to autoscaler: hold scale-down for 10m to let rollout settle. switched off batcher consolidation for that pool to avoid extra KV merging.

cheng: after hotfix and cordon: error rate dropped to baseline within ~3 minutes. last 2m: 0.3% errors and no new container restarts. Node still reporting kernel msgs about driver reset on one GPU, marking for replacement.

maria_cs: notifying affected customers now: sending interim message - investigating GPU memory errors impacting long-context sessions; temporary mitigation: auto-fallback to smaller model; ETA for full recovery: 15-30m.

alice_oncall: quick customer impact summary for incident timeline:
- Start: 2026-03-15T16:07:12Z (pager triggered).
- Impact: ~1.8% API errors (502/503) across prod for 12 minutes. Most affected: long-context enterprise customers on 96B pool.
- Mitigation: admission control (prefill size cap), fallback routing to 8B lowmem, runtime prefill-KV cap, cordon of node.
- Status: degraded -> reduced to baseline error within 10 minutes; node out-of-service for hardware follow-up.

david_ml: followups we should include in postmortem:
1) root cause: long prompt prefill + KV growth + GPU memory fragmentation + concurrent streaming allocations -> OOM and kernel reset.
2) short-term: keep prefill caps and fallback policies for all large-model pools; expand monitoring for KV growth per-request.
3) medium-term: runtime patch to pre-allocate and compact KV, better memcpy strategy, and model-level admission heuristics.
4) ops: schedule hardware replacement for GPU device on node rwd-infer-prod-usw2-nt-07.

priya_sre: adding action items to incident tracker now: `INC-2026-0315-1` (apply prefill caps across prod), `INC-2026-0315-2` (add KV growth alerting), `INC-2026-0315-3` (postmortem draft).

incident-bot: Incident severity set to Sev3 (customer-facing errors, mitigated).

alice_oncall: handing off to next oncall for monitoring and postmortem: @cheng you good to own the PM?

cheng: I’ll own the postmortem and follow-up runtime changes. I’ll collect heap/kernels, node diagnostics, and link metrics.

maria_cs: I’ll follow up with the notified customers after the postmortem is ready.

priya_sre: handing off pager to @ben_next_oncall in 5. Ben, if anything regresses ping infra.

ops-bot: handoff recorded: from alice_oncall -> ben_next_oncall at 16:25:00 UTC.

alice_oncall: closing thread for active mitigation. linking to postmortem once @cheng posts it. thanks all. :heart:
